summary: Iter40 pricing overhaul + scheduling endpoints tested end-to-end. BACKEND 35/37 PASS, 2 SKIP (iter40 test file). /api/billing/tiers returns all 40 slugs with correct Iter40 amounts (sole_trader_annual=5990, enterprise_annual=29990, retail_single_annual=7990, retail_enterprise_annual=39990, hosp_single_annual=11990, hosp_enterprise_annual=54990, trans_owner_annual=14990, trans_enterprise_annual=69990, health_solo_annual=24990, health_multi_annual=79990, health_enterprise_annual=179990, health_enterprise_monthly=17999, sole_trader_monthly=599). Plan right-sizer correct for all 5 scenarios: trades/1/1 → Solo Tradie A$5,990 with '5.1%' anchor (no stale 3.4%), hospitality/3/2 → Small Group A$22,990, transport/20/3 → Growing Fleet A$42,990, healthcare/40/4 → Enterprise A$179,990, retail/30/6 → Multi-Store A$24,990. Scheduling endpoints: GET /mandatory-credentials returns all 5 industries + healthcare has ahpra_registration + worker_screening, unknown industry→400. GET /check-eligibility unauth→401, cross-account worker→404, response shape has {can_roster, blockers, warnings, industry, worker_name}. Trades worker without white_card → blocked with kind='white_card'. POST /roster-gate returns results[] + blocked_count + clear_count. Regression all green: /api/demo-requests, /api/regulatory-digest, /api/compliance-inbox, /api/public/industry-signal/trades. FRONTEND pricing verified via data-testid on /pricing: all 5 industry tabs show correct Iter40 amounts in all 4 tiers (20/20 prices correct). /enterprise shows A$2,999/A$29,990 trades and A$17,999/A$179,990 healthcare + 25.6% anchor (no 6.5% stale). /partners shows A$2,499 fee (no stale A$1,999). /compare clean (no sub-A$400 or A$1,299). Homepage shows 5 industry price cards A$5,990/A$7,990/A$11,990/A$14,990/A$24,990 + 5.1%/A$116,979 anchor (no 3.4%). ONE BUG FOUND: /franchises page still shows 'Network setup from A$20,000' instead of expected 'from A$25,000'.

ui_bugs.issue: Network setup price still shows 'from A$20,000 + GST' — Iter40 requires 'from A$25,000 + GST'. Screenshot captured: 'Franchisor network dashboard included. Network setup from A$20,000 + GST (master template library + configuration + onboarding support across every industry).'

action_items: Update /app/frontend/src/pages/Franchises.jsx — replace 'A$20,000' with 'A$25,000' in the 'Network setup from' banner. Review spec stated it should read 'from A$25,000'.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/scheduling.py is clean: proper HTTPException codes, async DB access, MongoDB _id excluded via projection={'_id':0} and doc.pop('_id',None), account_id scoped via $or {account_id, user_id} for legacy licences, UUID shift ids, 200-worker cap on roster-gate batch, 24-hour fitness-for-duty rolling window, 14-day warning horizon.
MANDATORY_BY_INDUSTRY constant is the single source of truth — cleanly reused by both /check-eligibility and /mandatory-credentials public reference endpoint.

Licence kind matching uses substring heuristic on lines 168-170 (`req in fk or req.replace('_','') in fk.replace('_','')`). Works but could yield false positives (e.g. 'white_card_refresher' would incorrectly match 'white_card'). Low risk in current data.
billing.py BILLING_TIERS dict correctly lists 40 slugs with Iter40 amounts — format is consistent and tier/cycle pairs complete across 5 industries × 4 tiers × 2 cycles.

Scheduling ineligible path: HTTPException with status_code=409 uses detail={error, message, blocked[]} dict — FastAPI serialises this as response.detail = {...}, so frontend/tests must read response.json()['detail']['error']. Confirmed works.
